thread:
Eve R.: quick sync: predictive prefetch MVP - need cross-team blockers & gating by EOD Fri. short answers pls.
Sam B.: runtime: main unknown is multi-turn KV consistency. propose checksum per entry + seq-num. will add small perf hit.
Maya N.: infra: autoscaler cold-start ~40s. options: reserved warm slots or prewarm API. reserved has immediate predictability.
Chris D.: security: prefetch writes touch cached state; require isolated KMS key + immutable audit events. need short policy doc.
Eve R.: concrete acceptance ideas: median <=190ms, p90 <=430ms on pilot tenants; prefetch seeds >=70% of hot prefixes; cost uplift <=15%.
Sam B.: implementation note: hybrid seeding (top-prefix + trace-driven) looks best. estimates: 2 sprints if infra exposes prewarm endpoint.
Maya N.: timeline: can ship prewarm endpoint in ~4 workdays if we bump a low-prio infra task. otherwise reserved pool available now with +10% infra cost.
Chris D.: I'll draft KMS + audit template and post in #eng-security. need sample payloads for review.
Sam B.: monitoring checklist (short):
- prefetch_success_rate
- kv_checksum_failures
- end_to_end_p50/p90
- token_cost_uplift
Rollback if p90 regresses >25% or checksum failures >0.1%.
Maya N.: suggested canary: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 60% for 2h -> full if stable. health checks between ramps.
Eve R.: risks: cost runaway, throttling from higher token throughput, key rotation invalidating cached entries. add cost cap alarm and key-rotation TTL doc.
Sam B.: CRC per entry adds ~0.5ms but catches corruption. fine to include.
Maya N.: ops can set budget throttle at 1.25x pilot estimate. will provide cost delta by EOD Thu.
Chris D.: failure mode: prefetch fails -> fall back to cold path; log request id + failure reason to audit stream.
Eve R.: action owners & deadlines: Sam: seed algo + perf targets (EOD Thu); Maya: prewarm API vs reserved cost + schedule (EOD Thu); Chris: KMS + audit template (EOD Thu); ops: monitoring + runbook (EOD Thu).
infra-bot: reminder set: Fri 09:00 cross-team 15m checkpoint (calendar invite sent)
